crew.overview: After a catastrophic car crash, a young woman wakes up in a survivalist's underground bunker, where he claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack that has left the outside world uninhabitable.
crew.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane

crew.overview: In honor of his birthday, San Francisco banker Nicholas Van Orton, a financial genius and a cold-hearted loner, receives an unusual present from his younger brother, Conrad: a gift certificate to play a unique kind of game. In nary a nanosecond, Nicholas finds himself consumed by a dangerous set of ever-changing rules, unable to distinguish where the charade ends and reality begins.
crew.title: The Game

details.biography: Eric Roberts is a third-generation Special Effects technician. He was raised in the industry and was fortunate to receive direct tutelage from industry legend Cliff Wenger. Eric specializes in all aspects of fabrication and rigging. He also bears considerable knowledge in pyrotechnics due to a lifelong career of hands-on practical experience.
details.name: Eric Roberts
